premises.text: Illness detection today is too late—weeks/manual PCR after symptoms—so outbreaks move silently
premises.evidence_span: it takes weeks to detect illnesses, because many people don't even show symptoms. This means that illnesses are moving silently amongst us

premises.text: Sewage surveillance can detect symptomatic/asymptomatic/pre-symptomatic infection at community scale (e.g., 1 in 10,000)
premises.evidence_span: You measure a whole community with a single test. Even better, you can detect illnesses right from the beginning of infection, if they're symptomatic, asymptomatic, or pre-symptomatic. Best yet, you can detect one sick person in 10,000 people

premises.text: Manual sewage sampling and lab analysis is slow (up to a week) and costly (up to $1,000), limiting use to governments in crises
premises.evidence_span: A person has to take a sample from the sewer, drive it to the lab, then analyze it and send the data back. This means the data could take up to a week and cost up to $1,000

premises.text: Plug-and-play automated hardware/software installs in buildings and automates filtration, RNA extraction, and continuous PCR for up to 12 pathogens
premises.evidence_span: plug-and-play automated end-to-end hardware and software solution that can be installed into any and every building. Our product can detect up to 12 pathogens

premises.text: Same-day dashboard insights go to care homes, offices, factories and similar sites for outbreak prevention
premises.evidence_span: This data is sent directly to customers that day. This means that data can go directly to organizations that need it most. Care homes, offices, factories, and so much more

premises.text: Aggregated multi-site data can guide preventative healthcare, insurance, and public health policy
premises.evidence_span: Those data insights can be used to guide preventative healthcare solutions, insurance policy, public health policy, and so, so much more

domains.name: Late detection and manual sewage limits

value.text: Earlier community illness detection that prevents outbreaks in workplaces and care settings
value.evidence_span: providing a better way without testing whole communities

secondary_value.text: City/country-scale data for public health and insurance policy
secondary_value.evidence_span: guide preventative healthcare solutions, insurance policy, public health policy

causal_links.evidence_span: when an organization like the CDC gets their data, it's already too late and outbreaks already happened
Those data insights can be used to guide preventative healthcare solutions

notes: Three hardware stages (filtration, RNA extraction, continuous PCR) folded into one automated lab-workflow premise (P4) as process package of one mechanism. Patents pending treated as IP detail on that hardware. Singleton D3 retained: multi-site data market is a separately revisable value path beyond building installs.
